characters.name: Kavita
characters.appearance: Middle-aged Indian woman with a medium build and fair complexion. She has black hair pulled back and adorned with a white jasmine garland (gajra). She wears a prominent red bindi on her forehead.
characters.wardrobe: A solid green saree with a gold border. She wears a gold necklace with a black thread (mangalsutra), small gold earrings, and a gold bangle on her right wrist.
characters.demeanor: Authoritative, persuasive, and confident, delivering a strong motivational message.

scenes.supernova_script:
Kavita says: Listen to me carefully.
Kavita says: If you are still freezing when it is time to speak English, you are holding your own career back.
Kavita says: But if you start practicing today, you can finally build that confidence.
Kavita says: You think you don't have the time or money? Those are just excuses.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook: Tough-love behavior callout
- Names English immediately
- Sets up urgency and confidence aspiration without guaranteeing an outcome
